collectible.title: Miko's Headphones
collectible.subtitle: Drown out the desires you don’t want to hear
collectible.text:
Originally simple earmuffs, Miko commissioned the engineering-inclined Kappa to retrofit them into wireless headphones. Because Miko’s hearing is so acute, she needs headphones to block unnecessary sounds and allow her to focus. The symbol on the side is the Chinese character wa (和) meaning “Harmony”— as in you will never disrupt the harmony by challenging Miko’s power.

Anyway Miko’s giving you one of her spares because she’s so impressed with you. Wear it around to spread the glory of Miko.

“I believe this is what those in the outside world refer to as “branding”, is it not?”

collectible.title: Replica Seven-Star Sword
collectible.subtitle: Made in China
collectible.text: An almost-perfect copy of Miko’s sword, The Shichi-Sei Ken (Seven-Star Sword). Not the actual one, of course. Miko needs that.
collectible.unlock:
Witness Miko show her true power against Saki Nikaidou.
(Make sure Miko is naked but not masturbating when Saki has to take off her boyshorts, her last item of clothing.)

collectible.title: Newspaper
collectible.subtitle: Now it’s a real Touhou doujin!
collectible.text: A clipping from Gensokyo’s one and only newspaper, the Bunbunmaru. Details the goings-on and gossip surrounding the land of illusion’s inhabitants.

collectible.title: New Mask of Hope
collectible.subtitle: Made by Miko
collectible.text:
A mask made to represent the hopes of humanity. Needless to say, it takes the appearance of Miko. Originally given to the mask youkai Hata no Kokoro to help manage her emotions, it was rejected due to being too effective.

So, the Crown Prince has fobbed it off on you. Be grateful.
collectible.unlock:
Defeat Miko at a table full of characters who have a companion.
(In other words, beat some bitches who also bring other bitches.)
